title: Audit cleanup (low priority): Biblicus
description:
**Problem**
Low-severity findings from the 2026-10-20 audit of Biblicus.

**Evidence / Fix** (one checklist line per finding)
- [ ] docs API-reference links are dead while the docs site is disabled (resolves with the docs-site issue).
- [ ] README.md:743 shows `poetry run sphinx -b html docs docs/_build/html`; the command is `sphinx-build`.
- [ ] README license section omits that the license is MIT, and a stray section follows the link definitions.
- [ ] skills/ai-ml-corpus-retrieval/SKILL.md:12 and its references/ files contain an absolute `/Users/<developer>/Projects` path; use a relative path.
- [ ] A tracked directory with a leading space in its name (" /tmp/biblicus_test/", e.g. metadata/catalog.json, metadata/config.json) is accidental test output; delete it (`git ls-files | grep '^ '`).
- [ ] infrastructure/reinforcement-memory/cdk.out/ is committed and contains an AWS account ID; remove it from git and add it to .gitignore.
- [ ] Stale "Plexus" naming: docs/reinforcement-memory.md, footer.html:15 (a plexus.anth.us label), _llm.py:18, infrastructure stack.ts:16; rename to Primus (see the Plexus-to-Primus rename work).
- [ ] platform.aldea.ai documentation links fail DNS resolution; replace or remove.

**How to verify**
`git ls-files | grep -c '^ '` returns 0; `git ls-files | grep -c cdk.out` returns 0; `grep -rn 'Users/' skills/` returns nothing; `grep -rni plexus docs footer.html src infrastructure` returns nothing.

Source: Anthus repo audit, 2026-10-20.
